desc_en: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
desc_zh_game: 吸取对手的养分进行攻击。可以回复给予对手伤害的一半HP。

desc_en: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
desc_zh_game: 迅速撞向对手进行攻击。必定能够先制攻击。

desc_en: The foe is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 将强酸泼向对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 通过细胞的变化进行液化，从而大幅提高自己的防御。

desc_en: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 喷出能溶化对手的液体进行攻击。大幅降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The user nimbly strikes the foe. This attack does more damage if the user is not holding an item.
desc_zh_game: 轻巧地攻击对手。自己没有携带道具时，会给予较大的伤害。

desc_en: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.
desc_zh_game: 通过点穴让身体舒筋活络。大幅提高某1项能力。

desc_en: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.
desc_zh_game: 以敏捷的动作戏弄对手后进行切斩。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 发射空气旋涡进行攻击。容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
desc_zh_game: 支援我方或对手的行动，使其紧接着此招式之后行动。

desc_en: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 让身体放松变得轻盈，以便高速移动。大幅提高自己的速度。

desc_en: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 用锐利的风切斩对手进行攻击。容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 用连天空也能劈开的空气之刃进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.
desc_zh_game: 用神奇的力量瞬间移动，互换自己和同伴所在的位置。

desc_en: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 将头脑清空，瞬间忘记某事，从而大幅提高自己的特防。

desc_en: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain. The target becomes unable to flee.
desc_zh_game: 将锚缠住对手进行攻击。使对手无法逃走。

desc_en: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.
desc_zh_game: 用原始之力进行攻击。有时会提高自己所有的能力。

desc_en: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.
desc_zh_game: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势扑向对手。必定能够先制攻击。

desc_en: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.
desc_zh_game: 在自己身体的周围覆盖用水制造的幕。每回合回复HP。

desc_en: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
desc_zh_game: 如惊涛骇浪般挥动大尾巴攻击对手。

desc_en: The user looses a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.
desc_zh_game: 用张开着的双手猛推对手进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status problems affecting the user's party.
desc_zh_game: 让同伴闻沁人心脾的香气，从而治愈我方全员的异常状态。

desc_en: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
desc_zh_game: 通过神奇的芳香，提高我方宝可梦的特防。

desc_en: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.
desc_zh_game: 向我方紧急求助，从我方宝可梦已学会的招式中随机使用1个。

desc_en: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.
desc_zh_game: 如果此回合内对手已经受到伤害的话，招式威力会变成2倍。

desc_en: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 用尖叫声等突然惊吓对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 召唤手下，让其朝对手发起攻击。容易击中要害。

desc_en: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
desc_zh_game: ♂诱惑♀或♀诱惑♂，让对手着迷。对手将很难使出招式。

desc_en: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.
desc_zh_game: 从体内产生出波导之力，然后向对手发出。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射虹色光束进行攻击。有时会降低对手的攻击。

desc_en: This move reduces damage from attacks for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内减弱物理和特殊的伤害。只有冰雹时才能使出。

desc_en: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 削掉身体上没用的部分。大幅提高自己的速度，同时体重也会变轻。

desc_en: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.
desc_zh_game: 如果受到对手的招式攻击，就能给予该对手2倍威力的攻击。

desc_en: The user stares with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. Always goes first.
desc_zh_game: 用圆瞳凝视对手，从而降低其攻击。必定能够先制攻击。

desc_en: Protects the user from attacks. Also poisons any attacker that makes contact with the user.
desc_zh_game: 防住对手攻击的同时，让接触到自己的对手中毒。

desc_en: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.
desc_zh_game: 向对手投掷圆形物体进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 制造坚固的壁障，从而大幅提高自己的防御。

desc_en: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.
desc_zh_game: 和后备宝可梦进行替换。换上的宝可梦能直接继承其能力的变化。

desc_en: The user heats up its beak before attacking. Making contact in this time results in a burn.
desc_zh_game: 先加热鸟嘴后再进行攻击。鸟嘴在加热时对手触碰的话，就会使其灼伤。

desc_en: The user gets all the party Pokémon to attack the foe. The more party Pokémon, the more damage.
desc_zh_game: 我方全员进行攻击。同行的宝可梦越多，招式的攻击次数越多。

desc_en: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
desc_zh_game: 朝着对手打嗝，并给予伤害。如果不吃树果则无法使出。

desc_en: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.
desc_zh_game: 将自己的HP减少到最大HP的一半，从而最大限度提高自己的攻击。

desc_en: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.
desc_zh_game: 当对手未携带道具时，能够将自己携带的道具交给对手。

desc_en: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
desc_zh_game: 在2回合内忍受攻击，受到的伤害会2倍返还给对手。

desc_en: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the foe for four to five turns.
desc_zh_game: 使用长长的身体或藤蔓等，在4～5回合内绑紧对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 用尖锐的牙咬住对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user must rest on the next turn, however.
desc_zh_game: 用爆炸的火焰烧尽对手进行攻击。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

desc_en: The user launches a kick with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also leave the target with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 攻击对手后，有时会使其陷入灼伤状态。也容易击中要害。

desc_en: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.
desc_zh_game: 将猛烈的暴风雪刮向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。

desc_en: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.
desc_zh_game: 张开双手进行阻挡，封住对手的退路，使其不能逃走。

desc_en: The user attacks by engulfing the foe in a beautiful, yet intense, blue flame. It may also burn the foe.
desc_zh_game: 用美丽而激烈的青焰包裹住对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may leave the target with paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 用整个身体压住对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: The user charges at its foe, surrounding itself with lightning. It may also leave the target paralyzed.
desc_zh_game: 让强大的电流覆盖全身，猛撞向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: The user clubs the target with a bone. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 用手中的骨头殴打对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the target twice, coming and going.
desc_zh_game: 用手中的骨头投掷对手，来回连续2次给予伤害。

desc_en: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.
desc_zh_game: 用坚硬的骨头殴打对手进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.
desc_zh_game: 通过震耳欲聋的爆炸声产生的破坏力，攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。

desc_en: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.
desc_zh_game: 弹跳到高高的空中，第2回合攻击对手。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.
desc_zh_game: 收拢翅膀，通过低空飞行突击对手。自己也会受到不小的伤害。

desc_en: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.
desc_zh_game: 将手刀猛烈地挥下攻击对手。还可以破坏光墙和反射壁等。

desc_en: If the target's HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.
desc_zh_game: 当对手的HP负伤到一半左右时，招式威力会变成2倍。

desc_en: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
desc_zh_game: 用自己的身体狂舞挥打，给予对手伤害。

desc_en: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets' Speed stats.
desc_zh_game: 向对手用力吹起无数泡泡进行攻击。有时会降低对手的速度。

desc_en: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. It may also lower its Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 向对手猛烈地喷射泡沫进行攻击。有时会降低对手的速度。

desc_en: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
desc_zh_game: 咬住进行攻击。当对手携带树果时，可以食用并获得其效果。

desc_en: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 利用振动发出音波进行攻击。有时会降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.
desc_zh_game: 使出全身力气绷紧肌肉，从而提高自己的攻击和防御。

desc_en: The user strikes everything around it by stomping on the ground. It reduces hit Pokémon's Speed.
desc_zh_game: 用力踩踏地面并攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。降低对方的速度。

desc_en: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.
desc_zh_game: 向对手使出如子弹般快速而坚硬的拳头。必定能够先制攻击。

desc_en: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.
desc_zh_game: 向对手猛烈地发射种子进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. The user will no longer be Fire type.
desc_zh_game: 将自己全身燃烧起火焰来，给予对手大大的伤害。自己的火属性将会消失。

desc_en: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
desc_zh_game: 静心凝神，从而提高自己的特攻和特防。

desc_en: The user's type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water's edge, in grass, or in a cave.
desc_zh_game: 根据所在场所不同，如水边、草丛和洞窟等，可以改变自己的属性。

desc_en: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target is charmed into harshly lowering its Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: ♂诱惑♀或♀诱惑♂，从而大幅降低对手的特攻。

desc_en: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
desc_zh_game: 宝可梦为十分开心的你庆祝。

desc_en: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses next. It also raises the user's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 提高下一回合使出的电属性的招式威力。自己的特防也会提高。

desc_en: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射电击光束。由于蓄满电流，有时会提高自己的特攻。

desc_en: The user charmingly gazes at the foe, making it less wary. The target's Attack is harshly lowered.
desc_zh_game: 可爱地凝视，诱使对手疏忽大意，从而大幅降低对手的攻击。

desc_en: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the target.
desc_zh_game: 用非常烦人的，喋喋不休的音波攻击对手。使对手混乱。

desc_en: Seeking an opening, the user strikes continually. The foe's stat changes don't affect the damage.
desc_zh_game: 看准机会稳步攻击。无视对手的能力变化，直接给予伤害。

desc_en: The user throws the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
desc_zh_game: 扔飞对手，强制拉后备宝可梦上场。如果对手为野生宝可梦，战斗将直接结束。

desc_en: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user's very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.
desc_zh_game: 用非常坚固且厚实的贝壳，在4～5回合内夹住对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The user rubs its scales and makes a huge noise. Also lowers the user's Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 摩擦全身鳞片，发出响亮的声音进行攻击。攻击后自己的防御会降低。

desc_en: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.
desc_zh_game: 向对手投掷特殊的泥块进行攻击。使其能力变回原点。

desc_en: The user fights the foe up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user's Defense and Sp. Def.
desc_zh_game: 放弃守护，向对手的怀里突击。自己的防御和特防会降低。

desc_en: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 盘蜷着集中精神。提高自己的攻击、防御和命中率。

desc_en: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.
desc_zh_game: 用拳头怒涛般的殴打对手进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The user tells the target a secret. The target loses focus and its Sp. Atk stat is lowered.
desc_zh_game: 和对手进行密语，使其失去集中力，从而降低对手的特攻。

desc_en: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
desc_zh_game: 显示奇怪的光，扰乱对手。使对手混乱。

desc_en: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发送微弱的念力进行攻击。有时会使对手混乱。

desc_en: The foe is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target's Speed.
desc_zh_game: 用触手或青藤等缠绕进行攻击。有时会降低对手的速度。

desc_en: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.
desc_zh_game: 将自己的属性转换成和已学会的招式中第一个招式相同的属性。

desc_en: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.
desc_zh_game: 为了可以抵抗对手最后使用的招式，从而使自己的属性发生变化。

desc_en: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
desc_zh_game: 模仿对手刚才使出的招式，并使出相同招式。如果对手还没出招则会失败。

desc_en: If the target has already moved this turn, the effect of its Ability is negated.
desc_zh_game: 如果给予过伤害的对手已经结束行动，其特性就会被消除。

desc_en: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
desc_zh_game: 汲取宇宙中神秘的力量，从而提高自己的防御和特防。

desc_en: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically raising its Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 用软绵绵的绒毛包裹住自己的身体进行守护。巨幅提高自己的防御。

desc_en: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the foe, harshly reducing its Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 将棉花般柔软的孢子紧贴对手，从而大幅降低对手的速度。

desc_en: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
desc_zh_game: 从对手那里受到物理攻击的伤害将以2倍返还给同一个对手。

desc_en: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
desc_zh_game: 一边可爱地撒娇，一边靠近对手进行攻击，还能夺取对手携带的道具。

desc_en: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 用大钳子敲打对手进行攻击。容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power.
desc_zh_game: 使用神奇的力量防住攻击我方的变化招式。但无法防住伤害招式的攻击。

desc_en: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 用两手呈十字劈打对手进行攻击。容易击中要害。

desc_en: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the foe. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 用毒刃劈开对手。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态，也容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 用利牙咬碎对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

desc_en: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. It may also lower the target's Defense.
desc_zh_game: 用坚硬的锐爪劈开对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

desc_en: The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.
desc_zh_game: 用骇人的力量捏碎对手。对手剩余的HP越多，威力越大。

desc_en: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all the other types.
desc_zh_game: 使用该招式的宝可梦，其属性是幽灵属性或其他属性时，效果会不一样。

desc_en: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.
desc_zh_game: 用镰刀或爪子等切斩对手进行攻击。还可以切断细的树木。

desc_en: The user swings both arms and hits the target. Ignores the target's stat changes.
desc_zh_game: 旋转双臂打向对手。无视对手的能力变化，直接给予伤害。

desc_en: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 从体内发出充满恶意的恐怖气场。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.
desc_zh_game: 将对手强制拖入黑暗的世界，从而让对手陷入睡眠状态。

desc_en: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射强光，并给予伤害。

desc_en: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
desc_zh_game: 召唤手下，让其附在自己的身体上。可以提高自己的防御和特防。

desc_en: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 将身体蜷曲变圆，从而提高自己的防御。

desc_en: A strong wind blows away the foe's obstacles such as Light Screen. It also lowers their evasion.
desc_zh_game: 用强风吹开对手的反射壁或光墙等。也会降低对手的闪避率。

desc_en: When this move is used, if the user faints, the foe that landed the knockout hit also faints.
desc_zh_game: 使出招式后，当受到对手攻击陷入濒死时，对手也会一同濒死。连续使出则会失败。

desc_en: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
desc_zh_game: 完全抵挡对手的攻击。连续使出则容易失败。

desc_en: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage foes. This may also sharply raise the user's Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 掀起钻石风暴给予伤害。有时会大幅提高自己的防御。

desc_en: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合钻入，第2回合攻击对手。还能用来逃离洞窟之类的地方。

desc_en: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.
desc_zh_game: 阻碍对手行动，之前使出的招式将在4回合内无法使用。

desc_en: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to foes. This attack never misses.
desc_zh_game: 发出魅惑的叫声，给予对手精神上的伤害。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike the area around the user. It may also cause paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 用耀眼的电击攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。有时会陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: Diving on the first turn, the user rises and hits on the next turn. It can be used to dive in the ocean.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合潜入，第2回合浮上来进行攻击。还可以潜入深海之中。

desc_en: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches that may also leave it confused.
desc_zh_game: 有节奏地出拳攻击对手。有时会使对手混乱。

desc_en: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.
desc_zh_game: 使用招式2回合后，会用无数道光束攻击对手。

desc_en: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.
desc_zh_game: 拼命地猛撞向对手进行攻击。自己也会受到不小的伤害。

desc_en: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.
desc_zh_game: 使用尾巴等拍打对手进行攻击。连续2次给予伤害。

desc_en: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes twice. May cause flinching.
desc_zh_game: 以胸口的螺帽为中心旋转，并连续2次挥动手臂打击对手。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.
desc_zh_game: 用2只脚踢飞对手进行攻击。连续2次给予伤害。

desc_en: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.
desc_zh_game: 用连环巴掌拍打对手进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
desc_zh_game: 通过快速移动来制造分身，扰乱对手，从而提高闪避率。

desc_en: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 从天空中向对手落下陨石。使用之后因为反作用力，自己的特攻会大幅降低。

desc_en: The user soars upward and drops at high speeds. Its Defense and Sp. Def stats are lowered.
desc_zh_game: 从天空中急速下降攻击对手。自己的防御和特防会降低。

desc_en: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 将强烈的气息吹向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.
desc_zh_game: 用尖锐的巨爪劈开对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.
desc_zh_game: 激烈地跳起神秘且强有力的舞蹈。从而提高自己的攻击和速度。

desc_en: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
desc_zh_game: 将身体当作锤子，向对手发动袭击，给予伤害。

desc_en: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.
desc_zh_game: 从大大的口中掀起冲击波攻击对手。

desc_en: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.
desc_zh_game: 将愤怒的冲击波撞向对手进行攻击。必定会给予40的伤害。

desc_en: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 释放出骇人的杀气，一边威慑一边撞击对手。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
desc_zh_game: 弹飞对手，强制拉后备宝可梦上场。如果对手为野生宝可梦，战斗将直接结束。

desc_en: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage dealt.
desc_zh_game: 用一个吻吸取对手的HP。回复给予对手伤害的一半以上的HP。

desc_en: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
desc_zh_game: 用拳头吸取对手的力量。可以回复给予对手伤害的一半HP。

desc_en: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user's HP.
desc_zh_game: 吃掉正在睡觉的对手的梦进行攻击。回复对手所受到伤害的一半HP。

desc_en: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.
desc_zh_game: 一边旋转，一边将尖喙刺入对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 像钢钻一样，一边旋转身体一边撞击对手。容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
desc_zh_game: 用身体坚硬的部分拍打对手进行攻击。连续2次给予伤害。

desc_en: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.
desc_zh_game: 使出浑身力气出拳进行攻击。必定会使对手混乱。

desc_en: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.
desc_zh_game: 向对手脚下释放出大地之力。有时会降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
desc_zh_game: 利用地震的冲击，攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。

desc_en: The user attacks the foe with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.
desc_zh_game: 用回声攻击对手。如果每回合都有宝可梦接着使用该招式，威力就会提高。

desc_en: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 从身体放射出怪异电波，让对手沐浴其中，从而大幅降低其特攻。

desc_en: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.
desc_zh_game: 向对手用力投掷大大的蛋进行攻击。

desc_en: The user electrifies the ground for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内变成电气场地。地面上的宝可梦将无法入眠。电属性的招式威力还会提高。

desc_en: If the target uses a move after being electrified, that move becomes Electric-type.
desc_zh_game: 对手使出招式前，如果输电，则该回合对手的招式变成电属性。

desc_en: The user hurls an electric orb at the foe. It does more damage the faster the user is.
desc_zh_game: 用电气团撞向对手。自己比对手速度越快，威力越大。

desc_en: The user captures and attacks foes by using an electric net, which lowers their Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 用电网捉住对手进行攻击。降低对手的速度。

desc_en: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.
desc_zh_game: 让对手在5回合内不能使用宝可梦携带的道具。训练家也不能给那只宝可梦使用道具。

desc_en: The target is attacked with small flames. It may also leave the target with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射小型火焰进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.
desc_zh_game: 让对手接受再来一次，连续3次使出最后使用的招式。

desc_en: An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.
desc_zh_game: 给予伤害，使对手的HP变得和自己的HP一样。

desc_en: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
desc_zh_game: 即使受到攻击，也至少会留下1HP。连续使出则容易失败。

desc_en: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.
desc_zh_game: 发射从自然收集的生命力量。有时会降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The user dances to compel the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.
desc_zh_game: 用神奇的节奏跳舞。使对手模仿自己的动作，从而将特性变成一样。

desc_en: The user attacks in an explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.
desc_zh_game: 爆发怒火攻击对手。自己的HP越少，招式的威力越小。

desc_en: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.
desc_zh_game: 引发大爆炸，攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。使用后自己会陷入濒死。

desc_en: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 发出看不见的神奇力量进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.
desc_zh_game: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势猛撞向对手进行攻击。必定能够先制攻击。

desc_en: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or has paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 当自己处于中毒、麻痹、灼伤状态时，向对手使出此招式的话，威力会变成2倍。

desc_en: The user draws up to the foe disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.
desc_zh_game: 悄悄地靠近对手，趁其不备进行殴打。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
desc_zh_game: 通过封锁，下一回合所有的宝可梦都无法逃走。

desc_en: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.
desc_zh_game: 刮起妖精之风，吹向对手进行攻击。

desc_en: A fake move developped by Team Rocket that is used to trick people into buying counterfeit TMs
desc_zh_game: 火箭队发明的一种虚假招式，用来诱骗人们购买假冒的招式学习器。

desc_en: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.
desc_zh_game: 进行先制攻击，使对手畏缩。要在出场后立刻使出才能成功。

desc_en: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 装哭流泪。使对手不知所措，从而大幅降低对手的特防。

desc_en: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
desc_zh_game: 对手的HP至少会留下1HP，如此般手下留情地攻击。

desc_en: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 撒出羽毛，笼罩在对手的周围。大幅降低对手的攻击。

desc_en: An attack that hits a target using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.
desc_zh_game: 能够攻击正在使用守住或看穿等招式的对手。解除其守护效果。

desc_en: The user draws up to the foe disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.
desc_zh_game: 悄悄地靠近对手，趁其不备进行殴打。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat rises drastically.
desc_zh_game: 如果使用此招式打倒对手，攻击会巨幅提高。

desc_en: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and flaps its wings. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 让火焰覆盖全身，振翅攻击对手。有时会提高自己的特攻。

desc_en: The user risks all to attack the foe. The user faints but does damage equal to its HP.
desc_zh_game: 拼命攻击对手。虽然自己陷入濒死，但会给予对手和自己目前HP等量的伤害。

desc_en: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 用大字形状的火焰烧尽对手。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it burned.
desc_zh_game: 用覆盖着火焰的牙齿咬住对手。有时会使对手畏缩或陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 用燃烧的鞭子抽打对手。受到攻击的对手防御会降低。

desc_en: A column of fire hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its Grass equivalent, it makes a sea of fire.
desc_zh_game: 用火柱进行攻击。如果和草组合，威力就会提高，周围会变成火海。

desc_en: The target is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 用充满火焰的拳头攻击对手。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.
desc_zh_game: 将对手困在激烈的火焰旋涡中，在4～5回合内进行攻击。

desc_en: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn the user is in battle.
desc_zh_game: 威力很高的招式，但只有在出场战斗时，立刻使出才能成功。

desc_en: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the foe in. The target instantly faints if it hits.
desc_zh_game: 让对手掉落于地裂的裂缝中进行攻击。只要命中就会一击濒死。

desc_en: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
desc_zh_game: 抓狂般乱打进行攻击。自己的HP越少，招式的威力越大。

desc_en: The user attacks the foe with a bursting flame. It also damages Pokémon next to the target.
desc_zh_game: 如果击中，爆裂的火焰会攻击到对手。爆裂出的火焰还会飞溅到旁边的对手。

desc_en: The user cloaks itself in flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user's Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 让火焰覆盖全身，攻击对手。积蓄力量并提高自己的速度。

desc_en: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射烈焰进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. It may also leave the target with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 让火焰覆盖全身，猛撞向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user also takes damage and may burn the target.
desc_zh_game: 让火焰覆盖全身猛撞向对手。自己也会受到不小的伤害。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user flashes a light that cuts the target's accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.
desc_zh_game: 使出耀眼光芒，从而降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 将身体的光芒聚集在一点释放出去。有时会降低对手的特防。

desc_en: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, it also raises the target's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 吹捧对手，使其混乱。同时还会提高对手的特攻。

desc_en: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 放出强力光束后，自己的特攻会大幅降低。

desc_en: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.
desc_zh_game: 快速投掷携带的道具进行攻击。根据道具不同，威力和效果会改变。

desc_en: The user restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP when the terrain is grass.
desc_zh_game: 回复对手最大HP的一半。在青草场地时，效果会提高。

desc_en: The user raises the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.
desc_zh_game: 使用神奇的力量提高在场的所有草属性宝可梦的防御。

desc_en: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合飞上天空，第2回合攻击对手。还可以飞到去过的城镇。

desc_en: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.
desc_zh_game: 从空中俯冲向对手。此招式同时带有格斗属性和飞行属性。

desc_en: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.
desc_zh_game: 提高气势，释放出全部力量。有时会降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 深深地吸口气，集中精神。自己的攻击会变得容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.
desc_zh_game: 集中精神出拳。在招式使出前若受到攻击则会失败。

desc_en: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.
desc_zh_game: 引起对手的注意，将对手的攻击全部转移到自己身上。

desc_en: The target is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 向对手的身体发出冲击波进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any kind of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.
desc_zh_game: 对幽灵属性宝可梦没有效果的招式以及闪避率高的对手，使用后变得能够打中。

desc_en: The user puts a forest curse on the target. The target is now Grass type as well.
desc_zh_game: 向对手施加森林诅咒。中了诅咒的对手会被追加草属性。

desc_en: The user turns the foe's power against it. It does more damage the higher the target's Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 利用对手的力量进行攻击。正和自己战斗的对手，其攻击越高，伤害越大。

desc_en: The user rapidly cools the target. This may freeze the target. Is super-effective on Water types.
desc_zh_game: 急剧冷冻对手，有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。对于水属性宝可梦也是效果绝佳。

desc_en: On the second turn, the user hits the foe with electrically charged ice. It may also paralyze the foe.
desc_zh_game: 用覆盖着电流的冰块，在第2回合撞向对手。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: The user slams the target with an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.
desc_zh_game: 用大树摔打对手进行攻击。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

desc_en: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.
desc_zh_game: 将冰冷的气息吹向对手进行攻击。必定会击中要害。

desc_en: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
desc_zh_game: 为了发泄不满而全力攻击对手。亲密度越低，威力越大。

desc_en: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.
desc_zh_game: 用角或喙刺向对手进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.
desc_zh_game: 用镰刀或爪子等切斩对手进行攻击。连续击中，威力就会提高。

desc_en: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.
desc_zh_game: 用爪子或镰刀等抓对手进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The user throws down a giant thunderbolt. It does more damage if influenced by an enormous flame.
desc_zh_game: 释放出巨大的闪电。受到巨大的火焰影响时，招式威力会提高。

desc_en: The user brings down a giant flame. It does more damage if influenced by an enormous thunderbolt.
desc_zh_game: 释放出巨大的火焰。受到巨大的闪电影响时，招式威力会提高。

desc_en: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
desc_zh_game: 在使用招式2回合后，向对手发送一团念力进行攻击。

desc_en: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid negates the effect of the target's Ability.
desc_zh_game: 将胃液吐向对手的身体。沾上的胃液会消除对手的特性效果。

desc_en: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at its target.
desc_zh_game: 向对手投掷钢铁齿轮进行攻击。连续2次给予伤害。

desc_en: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk of allies with the Plus or Minus Ability.
desc_zh_game: 启动齿轮，提高特性为正电和负电的宝可梦的攻击和特攻。

desc_en: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合吸收能量，第2回合大幅提高特攻、特防和速度。

desc_en: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
desc_zh_game: 吸取对手的养分进行攻击。可以回复给予对手伤害的一半HP。

desc_en: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.
desc_zh_game: 使出自己浑身力量突击对手。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

desc_en: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at the foe. This attack reduces the targets' Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 将冰冻的冷气吹向对手进行攻击。会降低对手的速度。

desc_en: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 用腹部的花纹使对手害怕，从而让其陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.
desc_zh_game: 用草缠住并绊倒对手。对手越重，威力越大。

desc_en: A column of grass hits the foes. When used with its water equivalent, it creates a vast swamp.
desc_zh_game: 用草柱进行攻击。如果和水组合，威力就会提高，周围会变成湿地。

desc_en: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the target into a deep sleep.
desc_zh_game: 让对手听舒适的笛声，从而陷入睡眠状态。

desc_en: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns. Grounded Pokémon restore a little HP every turn.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内变成青草场地。地面上的宝可梦每回合都能回复。草属性的招式威力还会提高。

desc_en: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内，飘浮特性和飞行属性的宝可梦会被地面属性的招式击中。飞向空中的招式也将无法使用。

desc_en: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The foe's Attack stat is lowered.
desc_zh_game: 让对手听可爱的叫声，引开注意力使其疏忽，从而降低对手的攻击。

desc_en: The user's body grows all at once, raising the Atk and Sp. Atk stats.
desc_zh_game: 让身体一下子长大，从而提高攻击和特攻。

desc_en: If the user faints, the user's grudge fully depletes the PP of the foe's move that knocked it out.
desc_zh_game: 因对手的招式而陷入濒死时给对手施加怨念，让该招式的PP变成0。

desc_en: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target.
desc_zh_game: 利用超能力将自己和对手的防御和特防相加，再进行平分。

desc_en: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.
desc_zh_game: 利用超能力互换自己和对手的防御以及特防的能力变化。

desc_en: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.
desc_zh_game: 用大钳子或剪刀等夹断对手进行攻击。只要命中就会一击濒死。

desc_en: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may also poison the target.
desc_zh_game: 用肮脏的垃圾撞向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

desc_en: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.
desc_zh_game: 用翅膀将刮起的狂风袭向对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.
desc_zh_game: 让身体高速旋转并撞击对手。速度比对手越慢，威力越大。

desc_en: The user summons a hail storm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内一直降冰雹，除冰属性的宝可梦以外，给予全体宝可梦伤害。

desc_en: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.
desc_zh_game: 挥舞强力而沉重的拳头，给予对手伤害。自己的速度会降低。

desc_en: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
desc_zh_game: 如果使用欢乐时光，战斗后得到的钱会翻倍。

desc_en: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 全身使劲，让身体变硬，从而提高自己的防御。

desc_en: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
desc_zh_game: 升起黑雾，将正在场上战斗的全体宝可梦的能力变回原点。

desc_en: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging into the foe. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 将头伸出，笔直地扑向对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user charges its head into the foe, using its powerful guard hair. The user also takes damage.
desc_zh_game: 用厉害的爆炸头猛撞向对手进行攻击。自己也会受到少许伤害。

desc_en: The user attacks the foe with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. The user also takes terrible damage.
desc_zh_game: 拼命使出浑身力气，向对手进行头锤攻击。自己也会受到非常大的伤害。

desc_en: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.
desc_zh_game: 让同伴听舒适的铃音，从而治愈我方全员的异常状态。

desc_en: For five turns, the foe is prevented from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内无法通过招式、特性或携带的道具来回复HP。

desc_en: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.
desc_zh_game: 虽然自己陷入濒死，但可以治愈后备上场的宝可梦的异常状态以及回复HP。

desc_en: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.
desc_zh_game: 召唤手下疗伤。回复自己最大HP的一半。

desc_en: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP.
desc_zh_game: 放出治愈波动，从而回复对手最大HP的一半。

desc_en: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the foe less wary. It may also cause flinching.
desc_zh_game: 以可爱的动作使对手疏忽，乘机给出强烈的一击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.
desc_zh_game: 利用超能力互换自己和对手之间的能力变化。

desc_en: The user slams the foe with its flaming body. The heavier the user is, the greater the damage.
desc_zh_game: 用燃烧的身体撞向对手进行攻击。自己比对手越重，威力越大。

desc_en: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on the opposing team. It may also leave targets with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 将炎热的气息吹向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user slams into the foe with its heavy body. The heavier the user, the greater the damage.
desc_zh_game: 用沉重的身体撞向对手进行攻击。自己比对手越重，威力越大。

desc_en: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.
desc_zh_game: 帮助伙伴。被帮助的宝可梦，其招式威力变得比平时大。

desc_en: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.
desc_zh_game: 接二连三地进行攻击。对处于异常状态的对手给予较大的伤害。

desc_en: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.
desc_zh_game: 招式的属性会随着使用此招式的宝可梦而改变。

desc_en: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.
desc_zh_game: 招式的属性会随着使用此招式的宝可梦而改变。

desc_en: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
desc_zh_game: 使出全身力量，猛攻对手。

desc_en: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.
desc_zh_game: 跳起后用膝盖撞对手进行攻击。如果撞偏则自己会受到伤害。

desc_en: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.
desc_zh_game: 在攻击的时候手下留情，从而使对手的HP至少会留下1HP。

desc_en: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.
desc_zh_game: 我方宝可梦之间牵手。能带来非常幸福的心情。

desc_en: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 将爪子磨得更加锋利。提高自己的攻击和命中率。

desc_en: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
desc_zh_game: 用尖锐的角攻击对手。

desc_en: The user stabs the foe with a horn that rotates like a drill. If it hits, the target faints instantly.
desc_zh_game: 用旋转的角刺入对手进行攻击。只要命中就会一击濒死。

desc_en: The user drains the foe's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by half the damage inflicted.
desc_zh_game: 将角刺入，吸取对手的养分。可以回复给予对手伤害的一半HP。

desc_en: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 大声吼叫提高气势，从而提高自己的攻击。

desc_en: The user wraps its foe in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the foe.
desc_zh_game: 用强烈的风席卷对手进行攻击。有时会使对手混乱。

desc_en: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user must rest on the next turn, however.
desc_zh_game: 向对手喷射水炮进行攻击。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

desc_en: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
desc_zh_game: 向对手猛烈地喷射大量水流进行攻击。

desc_en: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射强烈的光线进行攻击。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

desc_en: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 用锋利的门牙牢牢地咬住对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: Unleashes a barrage of multi-arm attacks, skipping protections. The user's Defense stat falls.
desc_zh_game: 用许多手臂，无视对手的守住或看穿等招式进行连续攻击，自己的防御会降低。

desc_en: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. Skips protections.
desc_zh_game: 通过异次元洞，突然出现在对手的侧面进行攻击。还可以无视守住和看穿等招式。

desc_en: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.
desc_zh_game: 给予对手又吵又响的巨大震动进行攻击。

desc_en: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.
desc_zh_game: 施以诱导睡意的暗示，让对手陷入睡眠状态。

desc_en: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内连续滚动攻击对手。招式每次击中，威力就会提高。

desc_en: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射冰冻光束进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。

desc_en: On the second turn, an ultracold, freezing wind surrounds the foe. This may leave it with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 用能够冻结一切的强烈冷气，在第2回合包裹住对手。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
desc_zh_game: 用藏有冷气的牙齿咬住对手。有时会使对手畏缩或陷入冰冻状态。

desc_en: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.
desc_zh_game: 挥舞强力而沉重的拳头，给予对手伤害。自己的速度会降低。

desc_en: The target is punched with an icy fist. It may also leave the target frozen.
desc_zh_game: 用充满寒气的拳头攻击对手。有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。

desc_en: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.
desc_zh_game: 瞬间制作冰块，快速地扔向对手。必定能够先制攻击。

desc_en: The user attacks by harshly dropping an icicle onto the foe. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 用大冰柱激烈地撞向对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user launches sharp icicles at the target. It strikes two to five times in a row.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射锋利的冰柱进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the targets' Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 将结冰的冷气吹向对手进行攻击。会降低对手的速度。

desc_en: If the foe knows any move also known by the user, the foe is prevented from using it.
desc_zh_game: 如果对手有和自己相同的招式，那么只有对手无法使用该招式。

desc_en: The user attacks the foe with fire. The target's held Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.
desc_zh_game: 用火焰攻击对手。对手携带树果等时，会烧掉，使其不能使用。

desc_en: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. It leaves the target with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 用烈焰包裹住对手进行攻击。让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The target is infested and unable to flee for four to five turns.
desc_zh_game: 在4～5回合内死缠烂打地进行攻击。在此期间对手将无法逃走。

desc_en: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can't switch out.
desc_zh_game: 在大地上扎根，每回合回复自己的HP。因为扎根了，所以不能替换宝可梦。

desc_en: The user instructs the target to use the target's last move again.
desc_zh_game: 向对手下达指示，让其再次使出刚才的招式。

desc_en: The user disperses electrically charged particles. Normal-type moves become Electric-type.
desc_zh_game: 将带电粒子扩散开来，使一般属性的招式变成电属性。

desc_en: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 将皮肤变得坚硬如铁，从而大幅提高自己的防御。

desc_en: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 用钢铁般坚硬的头部进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 使用坚硬的尾巴摔打对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

desc_en: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.
desc_zh_game: 向对手放出无数的光弹。属性会根据自己携带的石板不同而改变。

desc_en: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.
desc_zh_game: 使出高高的腾空踢攻击对手。如果踢偏则自己会受到伤害。

desc_en: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 用锋利的手刀劈向对手进行攻击。容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target's accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 折弯汤匙引开注意，从而降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: Protects itself from damage. It also harshly lowers the Attack of attackers that make contact.
desc_zh_game: 防住对手攻击的同时，自己变为防御姿态。能够降低所接触到的对手的攻击。

desc_en: The user slaps down the target's held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.
desc_zh_game: 拍落对手的持有物，直到战斗结束都不能使用。对手携带道具时会增加伤害。

desc_en: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on foes to damage them.
desc_zh_game: 聚集大地的力量，将此力量集中攻击对手，并给予伤害。

desc_en: The user focuses intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
desc_zh_game: 集中精神，下次攻击必定会击中要害。

desc_en: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
desc_zh_game: 当战斗中已学会的招式全部使用过后，才能开始使出珍藏的招式。

desc_en: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 用熊熊烈火攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。有时会陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
desc_zh_game: 将叶片打向对手，进行攻击。

desc_en: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by slashing. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
desc_zh_game: 像用剑一般操纵叶片切斩对手进行攻击。容易击中要害。

desc_en: A storm of sharp is whipped up. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 用尖尖的叶片向对手卷起风暴。使用之后因为反作用力自己的特攻会大幅降低。

desc_en: The user attacks its foe by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the foe's accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 用锋利的叶片包裹住对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
desc_zh_game: 吸取血液攻击对手。可以回复给予对手伤害的一半HP。

desc_en: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.
desc_zh_game: 植入寄生种子后，将在每回合一点一点吸取对手的HP，从而用来回复自己的HP。

desc_en: The user gains an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target's Defense stat is reduced.
desc_zh_game: 用犀利的眼神使其害怕，从而降低对手的防御。

desc_en: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 用长长的舌头，舔遍对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: Fires a powerful beam of light drawn from the Eternal Flower. It also damages the user a lot.
desc_zh_game: 借用永恒之花的力量，发射出强力光线。自己也会受到不小的伤害。

desc_en: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.
desc_zh_game: 利用神奇的墙壁，在5回合内减弱从对手那里受到的特殊攻击的伤害。

desc_en: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. May lower the target's Defense.
desc_zh_game: 用水之力量撞向对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

desc_en: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.
desc_zh_game: 紧紧瞄准对手，下次攻击必定会打中。

desc_en: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it suceeds, the target falls asleep.
desc_zh_game: 用恐怖的脸强吻对手。让对手陷入睡眠状态。

desc_en: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.
desc_zh_game: 用力踢对手的脚，使其摔倒进行攻击。对手越重，威力越大。

desc_en: The user attacks the target's legs swiftly, reducing the target's Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 以敏捷的动作瞄准对手的脚进行攻击。降低对手的速度。

desc_en: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.
desc_zh_game: 向天许愿，从而在5回合内不会被对手的攻击打中要害。

desc_en: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.
desc_zh_game: 虽然自己陷入濒死，但可以治愈后备上场的宝可梦的全部状态。

desc_en: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This lowers the target's Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 全力猛扑对手进行攻击。从而降低对手的攻击。

desc_en: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 释放耀眼的光芒进行攻击。有时会降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.
desc_zh_game: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势出拳。必定能够先制攻击。

desc_en: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack will not miss.
desc_zh_game: 散落可以追踪对手的神奇叶片。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.
desc_zh_game: 当对手使出会变成异常状态的招式或寄生种子等时，会将对手的招式反射回去。

desc_en: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.
desc_zh_game: 制造出离奇的空间。在5回合内所有宝可梦携带道具的效果都会消失。

desc_en: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.
desc_zh_game: 将对手困在熊熊燃烧的火焰中，在4～5回合内进行攻击。

desc_en: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack will not miss.
desc_zh_game: 发射吸住对手的钢铁炸弹。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: Manipulates magnetic fields to raise the Defense and Sp. Def stats of allies with Plus or Minus Abilities.
desc_zh_game: 通过操控磁场，会提高特性为正电和负电的宝可梦的防御和特防。

desc_en: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
desc_zh_game: 利用电气产生的磁力浮在空中。在5回合内可以飘浮。

desc_en: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone around the user. Its power varies.
desc_zh_game: 晃动地面，攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。招式的威力会有各种变化。

desc_en: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves.
desc_zh_game: 将掀起来的榻榻米当作盾牌，防住自己和同伴免受招式伤害。变化招式无法防住。

desc_en: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
desc_zh_game: 用好似要勾人心魂的黑色目光一动不动地凝视对手，使其不能从战斗中逃走。

desc_en: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 唤醒身体深处沉睡的力量，从而提高自己的攻击。

desc_en: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe's intended move with greater power.
desc_zh_game: 提高威力，抢先使出对手想要使出的招式。如果不先使出则会失败。

desc_en: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
desc_zh_game: 吸取对手的养分进行攻击。可以回复给予对手伤害的一半HP。

desc_en: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
desc_zh_game: 用坚硬且华丽的角狠狠地刺入对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.
desc_zh_game: 使出力大无穷的重踢踢飞对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
desc_zh_game: 用充满力量的拳头攻击对手。

desc_en: The user faints when using this move. In return, it harshly lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.
desc_zh_game: 虽然会使自己陷入濒死，但是能够大幅降低对手的攻击和特攻。

desc_en: The user retaliates with much greater power against the target that last inflicted damage on it.
desc_zh_game: 使出招式前，将最后受到的招式的伤害大力返还给对手。

desc_en: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user's Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 用钢铁之爪劈开对手进行攻击。有时会提高自己的攻击。

desc_en: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 让对手听摩擦金属般讨厌的声音。大幅降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user's Attack.
desc_zh_game: 使出彗星般的拳头攻击对手。有时会提高自己的攻击。

desc_en: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
desc_zh_game: 挥动手指刺激自己的大脑，从许多的招式中随机使出1个。

desc_en: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.
desc_zh_game: 回复自己最大HP的一半。在战斗以外的时候使用，可将ＨＰ分给伙伴。

desc_en: The user copies the move last used by the foe. The move can be used until the user is switched out.
desc_zh_game: 可以将对手最后使用的招式，在战斗内变成自己的招式。

desc_en: The user attacks everything by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.
desc_zh_game: 让自己的头爆炸，来攻击周围的一切。自己也会受到伤害。

desc_en: The user senses the foe's movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the foe.
desc_zh_game: 用心感受对手的行动，下次攻击必定会击中对手。

desc_en: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.
desc_zh_game: 蜷缩身体显得很小，从而大幅提高自己的闪避率。

desc_en: Enables the user to hit a Dark type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.
desc_zh_game: 对恶属性宝可梦没有效果的招式以及闪避率高的对手，使用后变得能够打中。

desc_en: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
desc_zh_game: 从对手那里受到特殊攻击的伤害将以2倍返还给同一个对手。

desc_en: The user counters the target by mimicking the target's last move.
desc_zh_game: 模仿对手使用的招式，自己也使用相同招式。

desc_en: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target's accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 抛光自己的身体，向对手释放出闪光之力。有时会降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.
desc_zh_game: 用白雾覆盖身体。在5回合内不会让对手降低自己的能力。

desc_en: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Atk.
desc_zh_game: 用围绕着雾状羽毛的球进行攻击。有时会降低对手的特攻。

desc_en: The user covers the ground with mist for five turns. Grounded Pokémon can't gain status conditions.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内，地面上的宝可梦不会陷入异常状态。龙属性招式的伤害也会减半。

desc_en: The user attacks by borrowing the power of the moon. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 借用月亮的力量攻击对手。有时会降低对手的特攻。

desc_en: The user emits a sinister ray. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
desc_zh_game: 放出奇怪的光线攻击对手。可以无视对手的特性进行攻击。

desc_en: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
desc_zh_game: 回复自己的HP。根据天气的不同，回复量也会有所变化。

desc_en: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
desc_zh_game: 回复自己的HP。根据天气的不同，回复量也会有所变化。

desc_en: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target's accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射坚硬的泥弹进行攻击。有时会降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the target's accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 向对手喷射浑浊的水进行攻击。有时会降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. It also reduces the target's Speed.
desc_zh_game: 向对手投掷泥块进行攻击。同时降低对手的速度。

desc_en: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 向对手的脸等投掷泥块进行攻击。会降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric-type moves while the user is in the battle.
desc_zh_game: 一旦使用此招式，周围就会弄得到处是泥。在5回合内减弱电属性的招式。

desc_en: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. This move's type depends on the held memory.
desc_zh_game: 一边覆盖高能量，一边撞向对手进行攻击。根据存储碟不同，属性会改变。

desc_en: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 从口中喷出特别灼热的火焰进行攻击。降低对手的特攻。

desc_en: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk.
desc_zh_game: 谋划诡计，激活头脑。大幅提高自己的特攻。

desc_en: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.
desc_zh_game: 从树果上获得力量进行攻击。根据携带的树果，招式属性和威力会改变。

desc_en: An attack that makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the user's environment.
desc_zh_game: 用自然之力进行攻击。根据所使用场所的不同，使出的招式也会有所变化。

desc_en: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.
desc_zh_game: 向对手释放自然之怒。对手的HP会减半。

desc_en: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 用带刺的手臂猛烈地挥舞进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. It may also lower the target's accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 放出黑暗的冲击波攻击对手。有时会降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
desc_zh_game: 让在睡眠状态下的对手做恶梦，每回合会缓缓减少HP。

desc_en: The user makes the foe see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user's level.
desc_zh_game: 显示恐怖幻影，只给予对手和自己等级相同的伤害。

desc_en: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 抓住瞬间的空隙切斩对手。容易击中要害。

desc_en: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk.
desc_zh_game: 发出战吼威吓对手，从而降低对手的攻击和特攻。

desc_en: The user nuzzles its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 将带电的脸颊蹭蹭对手进行攻击。让对手陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: The user absorbs its target's HP. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage dealt.
desc_zh_game: 从锁定的对手身上吸取HP。回复给予对手伤害的一半以上的HP。

desc_en: The user attacks by spraying ink in the foe's face or eyes. It may also lower the target's accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 向对手的脸等喷出墨汁进行攻击。有时会降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.
desc_zh_game: 对幽灵属性宝可梦没有效果的招式以及闪避率高的对手，使用后变得能够打中。

desc_en: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.
desc_zh_game: 突然刮起毛骨悚然的暴风攻击对手。有时会提高自己的全部能力。

desc_en: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.
desc_zh_game: 用无数青白色且闪耀的光线攻击对手。

desc_en: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.
desc_zh_game: 在2～3回合内，乱打一气地进行攻击。大闹一番后自己会陷入混乱。

desc_en: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil sharply reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 使出全部力量攻击对手。使用之后会因为反作用力，自己的特攻大幅降低。

desc_en: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.
desc_zh_game: 将自己的HP和对手的HP相加，然后自己和对手友好地平分。

desc_en: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage dealt.
desc_zh_game: 给周围全体宝可梦造成伤害。可以回复给予伤害的一半HP。

desc_en: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches out.
desc_zh_game: 抛下狠话威吓对手，降低攻击和特攻后，和后备宝可梦进行替换。

desc_en: If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.
desc_zh_game: 蓄力攻击。如果能在对手之后攻击，招式的威力会变成2倍。

desc_en: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after battle.
desc_zh_game: 向对手的身体投掷小金币进行攻击。战斗后可以拿到钱。

desc_en: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.
desc_zh_game: 用尖锐的喙或角刺向对手进行攻击。

desc_en: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
desc_zh_game: 倾听歌声的宝可梦经过3回合陷入濒死。替换后效果消失。

desc_en: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.
desc_zh_game: 猛烈地刮起飞雪般的落花，攻击周围所有的宝可梦，并给予伤害。

desc_en: The user attacks by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
desc_zh_game: 在2～3回合内，散落花瓣攻击对手。之后自己会陷入混乱。

desc_en: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes on the next turn. Hits through protections.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合消失在某处，第2回合攻击对手。可以无视守护进行攻击。

desc_en: The user attacks with a pillar of light. This move uses the higher of the user's Attack or Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 用光柱来进行攻击。比较自己的攻击和特攻，用数值相对较高的一项给予对方伤害。

desc_en: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射锐针进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. Normal-type moves become Electric-type.
desc_zh_game: 用覆盖着电流的拳头进行攻击。使一般属性的招式变成电属性。

desc_en: The user and target become friends. The target loses its will to fight, lowering its Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 和对手和睦相处，使其失去战斗的气力，从而降低对手的攻击。

desc_en: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 与对手嬉闹并攻击。有时会降低对手的攻击。

desc_en: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
desc_zh_game: 用喙进行攻击。当对手携带树果时，可以食用并获得其效果。

desc_en: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.
desc_zh_game: 用有毒的牙齿咬住对手进行攻击。有时会使对手中剧毒。

desc_en: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.
desc_zh_game: 将毒瓦斯吹到对手的脸上，从而让对手陷入中毒状态。

desc_en: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm seeped with poison. It may also poison the target.
desc_zh_game: 用带毒的触手或手臂刺入对手。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

desc_en: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.
desc_zh_game: 撒出毒粉，从而让对手陷入中毒状态。

desc_en: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.
desc_zh_game: 将有毒的针刺入对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

desc_en: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 用尾巴拍打。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态，也容易击中要害。

desc_en: Fires an exploding pollen puff at enemies, or a HP-restoring one at allies.
desc_zh_game: 对敌人使用是会爆炸的团子。对我方使用则是给予回复的团子。

desc_en: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
desc_zh_game: 使用长长的尾巴或手等拍打对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The target is covered in a powder that explodes and damages it if it uses a Fire-type move.
desc_zh_game: 如果被撒到粉尘的对手使用火招式，则会爆炸并给予伤害。

desc_en: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the targets.
desc_zh_game: 将冰冷的细雪吹向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。

desc_en: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
desc_zh_game: 发射如宝石般闪耀的光芒攻击对手。

desc_en: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.
desc_zh_game: 利用超能力将自己和对手的攻击和特攻相加，再进行平分。

desc_en: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.
desc_zh_game: 利用超能力互换自己和对手的攻击以及特攻的能力变化。

desc_en: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 利用超能力交换自己的攻击和防御的力量。

desc_en: The user boasts of its strength. Power increases the more the user's stats are raised.
desc_zh_game: 耀武扬威地攻击对手，自己的能力提高得越多，威力就越大。

desc_en: Striking opponents repeatedly makes the user's fists harder, raising the user's Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 通过反复击打对手，使自己的拳头慢慢变硬。打中对手攻击就会提高。

desc_en: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the target.
desc_zh_game: 激烈地挥舞青藤或触手摔打对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The user attacks its foes by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.
desc_zh_game: 将大地的力量变化为利刃攻击对手。

desc_en: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.
desc_zh_game: 递给对手设有圈套的盒子进行攻击。也有可能回复对手HP。

desc_en: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.
desc_zh_game: 用棱镜的力量发射强烈光线。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

desc_en: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
desc_zh_game: 完全抵挡对手的攻击。连续使出则容易失败。

desc_en: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射神奇的光线进行攻击。有时会使对手混乱。

desc_en: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发送强大的念力进行攻击。有时会降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The user bites the target using psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.
desc_zh_game: 利用精神力量咬住对手进行攻击。还可以破坏光墙和反射壁等。

desc_en: Protects grounded Pokémon from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内，地面上的宝可梦不会受到先制招式的攻击。超能力属性的招式威力会提高。

desc_en: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.
desc_zh_game: 使出全部力量攻击对手。使用之后会因为反作用力，自己的特攻大幅降低。

desc_en: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 用实体化的心之利刃劈开对手。容易击中要害。

desc_en: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.
desc_zh_game: 利用超能力施以暗示，从而将自己受到的异常状态转移给对手。

desc_en: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
desc_zh_game: 向自己施以自我暗示，将能力变化的状态变得和对手一样。

desc_en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
desc_zh_game: 将神奇的念波实体化攻击对手。给予物理伤害。

desc_en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
desc_zh_game: 将神奇的念波实体化攻击对手。给予物理伤害。

desc_en: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射神奇的念波进行攻击。每次使用，伤害都会改变。

desc_en: This attack's power increases the more the target has powered up with stat changes.
desc_zh_game: 根据能力变化，对手提高的力量越大，招式的威力越大。

desc_en: The user heals the target's status condition. If so, it also restores the user's own HP.
desc_zh_game: 治愈对手的异常状态。治愈后可以回复自己的HP。

desc_en: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.
desc_zh_game: 当对手替换宝可梦上场时使出此招式的话，能够以2倍的威力进行攻击。

desc_en: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
desc_zh_game: 压制对手，从而将其行动顺序放到最后。

desc_en: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.
desc_zh_game: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势扑向对手。必定能够先制攻击。

desc_en: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. It may fail if used in succession.
desc_zh_game: 守护自己和同伴，以防对手的先制攻击。

desc_en: The user performs a beautiful dance. It boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
desc_zh_game: 轻巧地跳起神秘而又美丽的舞蹈。提高自己的特攻、特防和速度。

desc_en: As long as this move is in use, the user's Attack rises each time the user is hit in battle.
desc_zh_game: 如果在使出招式后受到攻击的话，会因愤怒的力量而提高攻击。

desc_en: The user scatters irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.
desc_zh_game: 将令人烦躁的粉末撒在自己身上，用以吸引对手的注意。使对手的攻击全部指向自己。

desc_en: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内一直降雨，从而提高水属性的招式威力。火属性的招式威力则降低。

desc_en: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.
desc_zh_game: 通过旋转来攻击对手。还可以摆脱绑紧、紧束、寄生种子和撒菱等招式。

desc_en: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 飞出叶片，切斩对手进行攻击。容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user cuts the foe with sharp shells. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 用锋利的贝壳切斩对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

desc_en: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit the foe on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 制造风之刃，于第2回合攻击对手。容易击中要害。

desc_en: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.
desc_zh_game: 让细胞再生，从而回复自己最大HP的一半。

desc_en: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
desc_zh_game: 使战斗中已经消耗掉的自己的持有物再生，并可以再次使用。

desc_en: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.
desc_zh_game: 利用神奇的墙壁，在5回合内减弱从对手那里受到的物理攻击的伤害。

desc_en: The user reflects the target's type, making it the same type as the target.
desc_zh_game: 反射对手的属性，让自己也变成一样的属性。

desc_en: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 让身体休息，治愈自己身上所中的毒、麻痹、灼伤的异常状态。

desc_en: An ancient song appeals to the hearts of those listening. It may also induce sleep.
desc_zh_game: 让对手听古老之歌，打动对手的内心进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入睡眠状态。

desc_en: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.
desc_zh_game: 连续睡上2回合。回复自己的全部HP以及治愈所有异常状态。

desc_en: Gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the last turn, this attack's damage increases.
desc_zh_game: 为倒下的同伴报仇。如果上一回合有同伴倒下，威力就会提高。

desc_en: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
desc_zh_game: 为了训练家而全力攻击对手。亲密度越高，威力越大。

desc_en: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user's type determines the type of this move.
desc_zh_game: 全力跳舞进行攻击。此招式的属性将变得和自己的属性相同。

desc_en: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.
desc_zh_game: 如果受到对手的招式攻击，就能给予对手2倍的伤害。

desc_en: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
desc_zh_game: 竭尽全力进行攻击。自己的HP越少，招式的威力越大。

desc_en: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
desc_zh_game: 放走对手，强制拉后备宝可梦上场。如果对手为野生宝可梦，战斗将直接结束。

desc_en: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.
desc_zh_game: 释放出扭曲时间般的强大力量攻击对手。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

desc_en: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射坚硬的岩石进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. It may also confuse the target.
desc_zh_game: 用尽全力扑向对手进行攻击。有时会使对手混乱。还可以攀爬悬崖。

desc_en: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 打磨自己的身体，减少空气阻力。可以大幅提高自己的速度。

desc_en: Large boulders are hurled at the foes to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.
desc_zh_game: 将大岩石猛烈地撞向对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the foe's Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 用拳头进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

desc_en: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.
desc_zh_game: 拿起小岩石，投掷对手进行攻击。

desc_en: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.
desc_zh_game: 投掷岩石进行攻击。封住对手的行动，从而降低速度。

desc_en: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射巨大的岩石进行攻击。下一回合自己将无法动弹。

desc_en: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's natural Ability.
desc_zh_game: 扮演对手，让自己的特性变得和对手相同。

desc_en: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 一边使身体快速旋转，一边踢飞对手进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内连续滚动攻击对手。招式每次击中，威力就会提高。

desc_en: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP.
desc_zh_game: 降到地面，使身体休息。回复自己最大HP的一半。

desc_en: The user tills the soil to encourage plant growth. This raises the Attack and Sp. Atk of Grass types.
desc_zh_game: 翻耕土地，使草木更容易成长。会提高草属性宝可梦的攻击和特攻。

desc_en: The user attacks with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.
desc_zh_game: 用歌声攻击对手。同伴还可以接着使出轮唱招式，威力也会提高。

desc_en: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 用神秘的火焰烧尽对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user attacks by slicing with its long horns. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage.
desc_zh_game: 用剑切斩对手进行攻击。无视对手的能力变化，直接给予伤害。

desc_en: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内被神奇的力量守护，从而不会陷入异常状态。

desc_en: Sand is hurled in the target's face, reducing its accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 向对手脸上泼沙子，从而降低命中率。

desc_en: Summons a five-turn sandstorm to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.
desc_zh_game: 在5回合内扬起沙暴，除岩石、地面和钢属性以外的宝可梦，都会受到伤害。岩石属性的特防还会提高。

desc_en: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.
desc_zh_game: 将对手困在铺天盖地的沙暴中，在4～5回合内进行攻击。

desc_en: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 向对手喷射煮得翻滚的开水进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.
desc_zh_game: 用恐怖的表情瞪着对手，使其害怕，从而大幅降低对手的速度。

desc_en: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.
desc_zh_game: 用坚硬且无比锋利的爪子抓对手进行攻击。

desc_en: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target's Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 发出不由自主想要捂起耳朵的刺耳声，从而大幅降低对手的防御。

desc_en: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave the foe with a burn.
desc_zh_game: 用熊熊烈火攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。有时会陷入灼伤状态。

desc_en: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user's environment.
desc_zh_game: 根据使用场所不同，该招式的追加效果也会有所变化。

desc_en: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in it does physical damage to the foe.
desc_zh_game: 用长角切斩对手进行攻击。角上拥有的神奇力量将给予物理伤害。

desc_en: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.
desc_zh_game: 将外壳坚硬的大种子，从上方砸下攻击对手。

desc_en: The user generates a shock wave from within its body. It may harshly lower the target's Sp. Def.
desc_zh_game: 从身体里产生冲击波。有时会大幅降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
desc_zh_game: 利用引力将对手甩飞出去。给予对手和自己等级相同的伤害。

desc_en: The user blows up to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.
desc_zh_game: 引发爆炸，攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。使用后陷入濒死。

desc_en: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
desc_zh_game: 投掷一团黑影进行攻击。有时会降低对手的特防。

desc_en: The user beats the target with a bone containing a spirit. May lower the target's Defense stat.
desc_zh_game: 用附有灵魂的骨头殴打对手进行攻击。有时会降低对手的防御。

desc_en: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 以影子做成的锐爪，劈开对手。容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user disappears, then strikes the foe on the second turn. It hits even if the foe protects itself.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合消失踪影，第2回合攻击对手。即使对手正受保护，也能击中。

desc_en: The user throws a punch from the shadows. The punch lands without fail.
desc_zh_game: 使出混影之拳。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.
desc_zh_game: 伸长影子，从对手的背后进行攻击。必定能够先制攻击。

desc_en: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.
desc_zh_game: 增加身体的角，变得棱棱角角，从而提高自己的攻击。

desc_en: The foe is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The target instantly faints if it hits.
desc_zh_game: 给对手一击濒死。如果是冰属性以外的宝可梦使用，就会难以打中。

desc_en: The user breaks its shell, lowering its defenses but sharply raising attacking and Speed stats.
desc_zh_game: 打破外壳，降低自己的防御和特防，但大幅提高攻击、特攻和速度。

desc_en: The user sets a shell trap. If it is hit by a physical move, the trap explodes and hurt the attacker.
desc_zh_game: 设下甲壳陷阱。如果对手使出物理招式，陷阱就会爆炸并给予对手伤害。

desc_en: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.
desc_zh_game: 转动齿轮，不仅提高自己的攻击，还会大幅提高速度。

desc_en: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.
desc_zh_game: 向对手快速发出电击。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.
desc_zh_game: 回复自己最大HP的一半。在沙暴中回复得更多。

desc_en: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.
desc_zh_game: 发射神奇的光线进行攻击。有时会使对手混乱。

desc_en: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user's stats.
desc_zh_game: 在风中掺入鳞粉攻击对手。有时会提高自己的全部能力。

desc_en: The user's mysterious psychic wave changes the target's Ability to Simple.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发送谜之念波。接收到念波的对手，其特性会变为单纯。

desc_en: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.
desc_zh_game: 让对手听舒适、美妙的歌声，从而陷入睡眠状态。

desc_en: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the foe. Once used, Sketch disappears.
desc_zh_game: 将对手使用的招式变成自己的招式。使用1次后写生消失。

desc_en: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.
desc_zh_game: 利用超能力互换自己和对手的特性。

desc_en: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the foe on the next turn.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合把头缩进去，从而提高防御。第2回合攻击对手。

desc_en: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. It may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 第2回合攻击对手。偶尔使对手畏缩。也容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user takes the foe into the sky, then drops it on the next turn. The foe cannot attack while airborne.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合将对手带到空中，第2回合将其摔下进行攻击。被带到空中的对手不能动弹。

desc_en: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.
desc_zh_game: 用冲向天空般高高的上勾拳顶起对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.
desc_zh_game: 偷懒休息。回复自己最大HP的一半。

desc_en: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.
desc_zh_game: 使用长长的尾巴或藤蔓等摔打对手进行攻击。

desc_en: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 用爪子或镰刀等劈开对手进行攻击。容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target.
desc_zh_game: 撒出催眠粉，从而让对手陷入睡眠状态。

desc_en: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
desc_zh_game: 从自己已学会的招式中任意使出1个。只能在自己睡觉时使用。

desc_en: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.
desc_zh_game: 用污泥投掷对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

desc_en: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.
desc_zh_game: 用污泥投掷对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

desc_en: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.
desc_zh_game: 用污泥波攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。有时会陷入中毒状态。

desc_en: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.
desc_zh_game: 扔石头或炮弹，攻击飞行的对手。对手会被击落，掉到地面。

desc_en: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
desc_zh_game: 用尖尖的角刺入对手进行攻击。攻击必定会命中。

desc_en: This attack inflicts double damage on a paralyzed foe. It also cures the target's paralysis, however.
desc_zh_game: 对于麻痹状态下的对手，威力会变成2倍。但相反对手的麻痹也会被治愈。

desc_en: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.
desc_zh_game: 将肮脏的浓雾吹向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

desc_en: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target's accuracy.
desc_zh_game: 向对手喷出烟或墨汁等，从而降低对手的命中率。

desc_en: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target's Sp. Atk stat decrease.
desc_zh_game: 没完没了地大声斥责，从而降低对手的特攻。

desc_en: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the foe attempts to use.
desc_zh_game: 将对手打算使用的回复招式或能力变化招式夺为己用。

desc_en: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
desc_zh_game: 在自己睡觉时，发出噪音进行攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

desc_en: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target's type to Water.
desc_zh_game: 将大量的水泼向对手，从而使其变成水属性。

desc_en: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.
desc_zh_game: 回复自己最大HP的一半。在战斗以外的时候使用，可将HP分给伙伴。

desc_en: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合收集满满的日光，第2回合发射光束进行攻击。

desc_en: The user gathers light energy into a blade, attacking the target on the next turn.
desc_zh_game: 第1回合收集满满的日光，第2回合将此力量集中在剑上进行攻击。

desc_en: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.
desc_zh_game: 将冲击波撞向对手进行攻击。必定会给予20的伤害。

desc_en: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.
desc_zh_game: 将对手连同周围的空间一起撕裂并给予伤害。容易击中要害。

desc_en: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
desc_zh_game: 让电流覆盖全身，猛撞向对手进行攻击。有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

desc_en: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any burnt Pokémon will be healed by these bubbles.
desc_zh_game: 随着唱歌会放出很多气球。受到此招式攻击时，灼伤会被治愈。

desc_en: The user hides in the target's shadow, steals the target's stat boosts, and then attacks.
desc_zh_game: 潜入对手的影子进行攻击。会夺取对手的能力提升。

desc_en: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
desc_zh_game: 将对手和自己的速度进行互换。

desc_en: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can't flee from battle.
desc_zh_game: 将黏糊糊的细丝一层一层缠住对手，使其不能从战斗中逃走。

desc_en: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
desc_zh_game: 向对手发射锐针进行攻击。连续攻击2～5次。

desc_en: The user lays a trap of spikes at the foe's feet. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.
desc_zh_game: 在对手的脚下扔撒菱。对替换出场的对手的宝可梦给予伤害。

desc_en: Protects the user from attacks. Also damages attackers that make contact with the user.
desc_zh_game: 防住对手攻击的同时，削减接触到自己的对手的体力。

desc_en: The user attacks while also stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent it fleeing.
desc_zh_game: 攻击的同时，缝住对手的影子，使其无法逃走。

desc_en: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.
desc_zh_game: 对对手最后使用的招式怀有怨恨，减少4PP该招式。

desc_en: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released all at once in an attack.
desc_zh_game: 将积蓄的力量撞向对手进行攻击。积蓄得越多，威力越大。

desc_en: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...
desc_zh_game: 也不攻击只是一蹦一蹦地跳，什么都不会发生……

desc_en: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.
desc_zh_game: 沙沙沙地撒满具有催眠效果的孢子，从而让对手陷入睡眠状态。
